briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-4 push frontier amid global compute scramble

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate releases as US-China tensions over chips intensify. Funding remains robust with multiple $1B+ rounds closing this quarter.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4-preview with 2.1T parameters; xAI released Grok-4; DeepSeek-V3.5 and Meta Llama-4-405B variants dropped this week. Anthropic Claude 3.7 Opus benchmarks show gains in reasoning.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 500k units/month; Google and Microsoft announce new 200MW data center clusters in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory caps on training runs above 10^26 FLOPs slow the US lead or accelerate offshore development?
